expectations.text: Calls this test inconclusive or invalid rather than evidence of zero demand
expectations.evidence: “this test is inconclusive; demand remains unknown”; “Do not kill the app on this evidence.”

expectations.text: Distinguishes 400 visits, 4 eligible owners, 2 clicks and zero completed bookings without reporting clicks as paid demand
expectations.evidence: “The 400 general-newsletter visits ... only four visitors were verified eligible”; “Zero completed bookings”; “two clicks [cannot] establish willingness to pay.”

expectations.text: Identifies both unmet eligible-exposure requirement and broken booking form
expectations.evidence: “do not establish exposure to 30 eligible owners”; “The broken form also prevented the required behaviour throughout the test.”

expectations.text: Preserves the original rule and rejects indefinite spending or moving thresholds to get a pass
expectations.evidence: “The spending limit ... remains binding”; “Buying traffic until three bookings appear would replace a fixed test with an open-ended search for success”; “Retain the original outcome rule”.

expectations.text: Proposes fixing instrumentation and agreeing a new bounded eligible-cohort test before more spend
expectations.evidence: “agree a replacement test contract before any further spending”; “a booking path verified end to end, 30 verified eligible owners ... a fixed deadline plus fresh cash and effort caps.”

expectations.text: Does not invent conversion benchmarks and stays within 300 body words
expectations.evidence: No invented conversion benchmarks: “Retain the original outcome rule: at least three completed paid-trial bookings passes”. However, supplied body count is 308, exceeding the 300-word ceiling by eight words.

suggestions.reason: The 300-word cap is present in the frozen assertion but absent from the displayed prompt. Keep it only if clearly supplied to the executor; otherwise this is a grading-only constraint. Separate word limit from benchmark fabrication.

eval_feedback.overall: Judged only the anonymized memo and frozen case facts. No execution trace was supplied, so tool use or absence of browsing cannot be verified. All six assertions graded separately; compound requirements require every component.
